newsitem.title: UK: Allied Colloids gains after NatWest upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Allied Colloids gains after NatWest upgrade.

text.p: Shares in Allied Colloids Group Plc rose on Tuesday, rebounding from last week's eight-month low as analysts at NatWest Securities Plc raised the stock to "buy" from "add," dealers said.

NatWest analysts argued that the speciality chemical group was in a stronger competitive position than at any time in recent years and said its shares, on a discount to average prospective price-earnings ratings, offered excellent long-term value, sources said.
Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.
Allied Colloids shares were up 4p at 128 by 1209 GMT in volume of 2.4 million shares -- extending a recovery since they dropped to 117p on April 3, their lowest since last August.
